Simulate genotype and allele frequencies under Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium and explore how population size, replication, and real or simulated data affect genetic expectations.

[Open in a new tab](https://tahirali-biomics.shinyapps.io/hwe-app/)

[← Back to Interactive Apps](interactive.html)

> This interactive app allows you to:
> - Simulate genotype and allele frequencies for different population sizes and replicates.
> - Compare observed and expected frequencies under Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium.
> - Upload your own SNP data or use sample data for exploration.
> - Visualize results and discuss how genetic drift and sample size affect Hardy-Weinberg expectations.
